purpose: Field registry for the Spatial Trajectory Analysis Layer 2 method-selection evidence package.

fields.name: Tool Name
fields.definition: Canonical method or tool identity in the frozen topic candidate set.
fields.fill_rule: Use the canonical method name from the frozen input JSON.
fields.topic_relevance: Defines the row identity for the trajectory-method candidate set.

fields.name: Method Family
fields.definition: Short algorithm-family label for the method.
fields.fill_rule: Use the Layer 1 registry family phrase, adjusted only when PubMed method-paper evidence supports a clearer topic label.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates optimal transport, RNA velocity, tensor dynamics, adversarial graph embedding, topological velocity, and causal trajectory routes.

fields.name: Main Input
fields.definition: High-level input object and signal expected by the method in this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use object-level phrasing; include spatial coordinates, splicing, histology, reference data, or multi-batch context only when directly relevant.
fields.topic_relevance: Trajectory methods differ strongly by whether they need spatial coordinates alone, spliced/unspliced signal, reference scRNA-seq, histology, or multi-batch data.

fields.name: Main Use in This Topic
fields.definition: Main role of the method inside Spatial Trajectory Analysis.
fields.fill_rule: Describe only trajectory, pseudotime, RNA velocity, state-transition, or causal-trajectory use; do not foreground unrelated downstream claims.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps multi-task methods scoped to trajectory selection.

fields.name: Main Output
fields.definition: High-level output object relevant to this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use a short object-level phrase such as trajectory topology, velocity field, transition tensor, latent pseudotime, or causal trajectory tree.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes trajectory topology, velocity, embedding, and causal graph outputs.

fields.name: Closest Alternatives
fields.definition: Nearby alternatives from the same frozen topic set.
fields.fill_rule: Use two to four local alternatives only; do not add methods outside the frozen candidate set.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports branch-local comparison without universal ranking.

fields.name: Key Difference
fields.definition: Main decision difference versus nearby alternatives.
fields.fill_rule: Use one decision-level sentence grounded in input/output and method-family differences.
fields.topic_relevance: Feeds branch-local method selection.

fields.name: Compute Requirement
fields.definition: Coarse compute requirement from the frozen registry and directly observed article evidence.
fields.fill_rule: Use CPU, Optional GPU, Required GPU, or unclear. Do not interpret this as BioHarness runtime readiness.
fields.topic_relevance: Acts as a branch-local resource gate after task fit is established.

fields.name: Memory Burden
fields.definition: Coarse memory burden for method use.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear. Prefer unclear when direct public evidence is weak or method-paper hardware is not enough to generalize.
fields.topic_relevance: Trajectory methods can involve graph, tensor, deep, or velocity models whose memory needs may affect later audit triage.

fields.name: Scale Sensitivity
fields.definition: Coarse sensitivity to larger spatial scale, many cells/spots, many slices, or multi-batch data.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear. Use unclear unless public evidence directly supports a label.
fields.topic_relevance: Spatial trajectory analyses may be fragile under atlas-scale, high-resolution, or multi-sample settings.

fields.name: Code Access
fields.definition: Current code-access state for the method.
fields.fill_rule: Record access state only; do not equate access with execution support.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports later representative Layer 3/4 audit triage.

fields.name: Primary Code Link
fields.definition: One primary code or official source location when confirmed.
fields.fill_rule: Fill only when a primary code location is present in the frozen registry input or PubMed/PMC data-availability text; otherwise leave empty.
fields.topic_relevance: Provides a traceable source for later engineering review without claiming execution support.

fields.name: Evidence Source
fields.definition: Main evidence basis for the row.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled source label.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes method-paper-local evidence from review or synthesized evidence.

fields.name: Evidence Note
fields.definition: Short note on what is direct evidence and what is Layer 2 synthesized judgment.
fields.fill_rule: Use one to two concise sentences. Mark comparator, resource, caveat, and decision fields as synthesized when appropriate.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps uncertainty and evidence strength visible.

fields.name: Best First Choice When
fields.definition: Best-fit starting condition within this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use one positive conditional sentence. Avoid universal-method claims.
fields.topic_relevance: Feeds the branch-local decision tree.

fields.name: Do Not Start With This When
fields.definition: Main condition where this method should not be the first method read or trialed.
fields.fill_rule: Use one concise exclusion sentence.
fields.topic_relevance: Prevents method misuse without claiming runtime failure.

fields.name: Trajectory Branch
fields.definition: Primary trajectory-analysis branch represented by the method.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value representing the dominant branch.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates trajectory topology, velocity, embedding/pseudotime, and causal-trajectory use cases.

fields.name: Splicing / Velocity Dependence
fields.definition: Whether trajectory inference depends on spliced/unspliced or RNA-velocity signal.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value; choose reference-imputed when spatial velocity is inferred through scRNA-seq reference enrichment.
fields.topic_relevance: RNA-velocity and non-velocity trajectory branches require different data assumptions.

fields.name: Spatial Coupling Mode
fields.definition: Dominant way spatial information enters the trajectory model.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value based on method-paper description.
fields.topic_relevance: Spatial trajectory methods differ by whether space shapes transition costs, random walks, graph constraints, differential equations, image features, or causal graph refinement.

fields.name: Reference Dependence
fields.definition: Whether the method depends on external reference data for trajectory inference.
fields.fill_rule: Use reference-free when no external scRNA-seq reference is central to the method; use scRNA-reference-assisted when the paper requires or foregrounds a reference.
fields.topic_relevance: Highlights reference mismatch and reference-bias risk in spatial velocity inference.

fields.name: Temporal / Multi-sample Cue
fields.definition: Whether the method directly foregrounds temporal intervals, multi-sample, or multi-batch trajectory analysis.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value based on direct paper claims; use unclear if the evidence is not explicit.
fields.topic_relevance: Trajectory tasks often differ by whether samples are independent sections, time intervals, or batches.

fields.name: Output Interpretability Cue
fields.definition: Main interpretability object produced by the method.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value matching the main output object.
fields.topic_relevance: Helps agents choose between topology, velocity, tensor, embedding, and causal explanations.

fields.name: Scientific Caveat
fields.definition: Concise caveat about biological interpretation, reference bias, topology assumptions, causal claims, benchmark limits, or validation limits.
fields.fill_rule: Use conservative free text. Do not turn caveats into a severity score.
fields.topic_relevance: Carries scientific-critical-thinking concerns into branch-local selection.
